cards.whyItMatters: 时间序列预测中单一模型性能易受数据分布变化影响，集成权重自适应调整有助于在分布漂移和机制转换下维持稳健预测，对污染管理、能源规划和灾害强度估计等应用具有参考价值。
cards.summary: 该论文提出一种基于自适应鲁棒优化的集成方法，为时间序列预测模型构建随时间自适应的线性回归权重。作者在八种扰动场景的合成实验和空气污染、能源消耗、热带气旋强度三个真实应用中验证方法，报告自适应集成在真实应用中相对事后最优成员将RMSE降低16-26%，并将15%水平下的条件风险价值降低14-28%。合成实验中，该方法在八个场景中的七个平均RMSE低于滚动岭回归对比方法，其中四个显著更低。
keyPointsEn: The core method uses Adaptive Robust Optimization (ARO) to construct a linear regression ensemble whose model weights adapt over time.

Real-world applications cover air pollution management, energy consumption forecasting, and tropical cyclone intensity forecasting; adaptive ensembles outperform the best ensemble member in hindsight and most compared ensemble methods on RMSE and 15% conditional value at risk.
Synthetic experiments span eight disturbance scenarios from no drift to abrupt regime shifts; the method has lower mean RMSE than rolling-ridge in seven scenarios, significantly in four.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Single-model time series forecasting performance is sensitive to shifts in data distribution; adaptive ensemble weighting can help maintain robust predictions under distribution drift and regime shifts, with reference value for pollution management, energy planning, and hazard intensity estimation.
cards.title: 自适应鲁棒优化构建时变权重集成预测模型
cards.description: 提出用自适应鲁棒优化（ARO）为时间序列集成模型构建随时间自适应的线性回归权重，在合成与真实数据中提升了预测精度与尾部风险表现。
keyPoints: 方法核心是用自适应鲁棒优化（ARO）构建线性回归集成，模型权重随时间变化。
真实应用覆盖空气污染管理、能源消耗预测和热带气旋强度预测，自适应集成在RMSE和15%条件风险价值上优于事后最优成员及多数对比集成方法。
合成实验覆盖从无漂移到突变机制转换的八种扰动场景，该方法在七个场景平均RMSE低于滚动岭回归，四个场景显著更低。
cards.limitations: 合成实验中，若突变机制转换在模型选择之后才首次出现，该方法仍存在局限；真实应用结果基于论文所选数据集与对比方法，未覆盖所有可能的漂移类型或部署条件，结论应视为该研究设定下的证据。
cards.originalTitle: Ensemble Modeling for Time Series Forecasting: an Adaptive Robust Optimization Approach
cards.titleEn: Adaptive Robust Optimization Builds Time-Varying Weight Ensemble Forecasting Models
cards.descriptionEn: Proposes using Adaptive Robust Optimization (ARO) to build time-adaptive linear regression weights for time series ensembles, improving forecasting accuracy and tail risk performance in synthetic and real-world data.
cards.summaryEn: The paper proposes an ensemble method based on Adaptive Robust Optimization (ARO) that constructs time-adaptive linear regression weights for time series forecasting models. The authors validate the method on synthetic experiments covering eight disturbance scenarios and three real-world applications—air pollution management, energy consumption forecasting, and tropical cyclone intensity forecasting—reporting that adaptive ensembles reduce RMSE by 16-26% and conditional value at risk at the 15% level by 14-28% relative to the best ensemble member in hindsight. In synthetic experiments, the method has lower mean RMSE than a rolling-ridge comparator in seven of eight scenarios, significantly in four.
cards.limitationsEn: In synthetic experiments, an abrupt regime shift that first appears after model selection remains a limitation; real-world results are based on the paper's selected datasets and comparison methods and do not cover all possible drift types or deployment conditions, so conclusions should be viewed as evidence under the study's settings.

cards.whyItMatters: 该研究提示，在尾部风险与结构变化背景下，仅以方差或CVaR优化降低下行风险，不一定能提升风险调整后收益；等权策略在样本内仍具竞争力。对关注ETF组合分散化与期权隐含信息的研究者和从业者，提供了权衡风险降低、绩效与实施成本的实证参照。
cards.summary: 研究使用2020—2024年全球30只ETF的日收益，在滚动窗口中比较最小方差和CVaR优化组合与等权基准的表现。优化组合的经验VaR和CVaR低于基准，多空策略进一步降低下行风险，但等权基准的Sharpe、Sortino和Rachev比率最高；GARCH在信息准则下优于FIGARCH。作者基于历史估计的NIG模型生成期权价格和隐含波动率曲面，并指出风险降低、风险调整后表现与实施成本之间存在权衡。
keyPointsEn: Optimized portfolios show lower empirical VaR and CVaR than the equally weighted benchmark, with long-short strategies providing greater downside-risk reduction.
The equally weighted benchmark achieves the highest Sharpe, Sortino, and Rachev ratios, so optimization does not improve risk-adjusted performance in-sample.
GARCH outperforms FIGARCH according to information criteria.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The study suggests that under tail risk and structural change, reducing downside risk via variance or CVaR optimization does not necessarily improve risk-adjusted returns, and equal weighting remains competitive in-sample. It offers an empirical reference for researchers and practitioners on trade-offs among risk reduction, performance, and implementation costs in ETF diversification and option-implied information.
cards.title: 尾部风险下股债分散化再审视：全球ETF与期权隐含波动率证据
cards.description: 该研究基于2020—2024年美国、加拿大和澳大利亚上市的30只股票—债券及多资产ETF的美元日收益，在滚动窗口框架下比较最小方差与CVaR优化组合（多头与多空）与等权基准，并利用历史估计的Normal Inverse Gaussian模型生成欧式期权价格及隐含波动率曲面。新意在于将尾部风险度量、结构变化与模型隐含期权价格整合，为分散化策略的权衡提供实证参考。
keyPoints: 优化组合的经验VaR和CVaR低于等权基准，多空策略的下行风险降低更明显。
等权基准在Sharpe、Sortino和Rachev比率上表现最高，优化组合未在风险调整后收益上胜出。
GARCH在信息准则比较中优于FIGARCH。
cards.limitations: 样本限于2020—2024年美国、加拿大和澳大利亚上市的30只ETF，结论不宜直接外推至其他市场或资产类别。优化与基准比较依赖滚动窗口设定和美元日收益，未涵盖交易成本、税收等实施摩擦的完整量化。NIG期权定价基于历史估计与Martingale修正，其隐含波动率曲面的实证有效性需独立验证。
cards.originalTitle: Revisiting Equity-Bond Diversification under Tail Risk and Structural Market Change: Evidence from Global ETFs and Model-Implied Option Prices
cards.titleEn: Revisiting Equity-Bond Diversification under Tail Risk: Evidence from Global ETFs and Model-Implied Option Prices
cards.descriptionEn: Using daily U.S.-dollar returns of 30 equity-bond and multi-asset ETFs listed in the U.S., Canada, and Australia over 2020–2024, the study compares minimum-variance and CVaR portfolio optimization (long-only and long-short) against an equally weighted benchmark in a rolling-window framework, and generates European option prices and implied volatility surfaces from a historically estimated Normal Inverse Gaussian model. Its novelty lies in integrating tail-risk measures, struc
cards.summaryEn: The study uses daily returns of 30 global ETFs from 2020 to 2024 to compare minimum-variance and CVaR-optimized portfolios with an equally weighted benchmark in rolling windows. Optimized portfolios exhibit lower empirical VaR and CVaR than the benchmark, with long-short strategies reducing downside risk further, but the equally weighted benchmark achieves the highest Sharpe, Sortino, and Rachev ratios; GARCH outperforms FIGARCH under information criteria. The authors generate option prices and implied volatility surfaces from a historically estimated NIG model and highlight trade-offs among risk reduction, risk-adjusted performance, and implementation costs.
cards.limitationsEn: The sample is limited to 30 ETFs listed in the U.S., Canada, and Australia over 2020–2024, so findings may not generalize to other markets or asset classes. Portfolio comparisons depend on rolling-window specifications and U.S.-dollar daily returns, and do not fully quantify implementation frictions such as transaction costs and taxes. The NIG option pricing relies on historical estimation and a martingale correction, and the empirical validity of its implied volatility surfaces requires independent verification.

cards.whyItMatters: 该工作为递归寿命预测中的结构约束强度提供了可量化的治理视角，有助于在监管场景下平衡预测精度与稳定性，并连接精算可信度理论与神经网络预测。
cards.summary: 作者提出 AINN 框架，在 6 个高寿命国家的数据上训练带单调性约束的 LSTM，发现 λ 从 0.01 增至 0.1 时，30 年预测置信区间分别收窄 6.5% 和 25%，RMSE 代价分别为零和 +0.84%。作者认为标准超参数优化器因最小化一步 RMSE 而无法识别这一权衡。10 年样本外回测平均绝对误差为 0.38 年，12 个国家×性别组合中 11 个落在 90% 置信区间内。
keyPointsEn: At λ=0.01, 30-year forecast confidence intervals narrow by 6.5% at zero RMSE cost; at λ=0.1, they narrow by 25% at only +0.84% RMSE cost.
Standard hyperparameter optimizers select λ by minimizing one-step RMSE, which the authors argue is the wrong metric for structural constraints in recursive forecasting.
Residual-calibrated process noise reduces confidence intervals by 53-60% relative to a dual uncertainty framework, and a 5-seed ensemble achieves a coefficient of variation of 1.06%.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The work offers a quantifiable governance perspective on structural constraint intensity in recursive longevity forecasting, helping balance accuracy and stability in regulatory contexts and linking actuarial credibility theory with neural network predictions.
cards.title: 精算约束神经网络提升多人口寿命预测稳定性
cards.description: 该研究提出精算信息神经网络（AINN），通过可微惩罚项将单调性等精算知识嵌入 LSTM 训练，用于性别特定的多人口寿命预测。其新意在于揭示约束强度 λ 可作为连续治理旋钮，在几乎不损失精度的前提下收窄预测区间，并量化了精度-稳定性权衡。
keyPoints: λ=0.01 时 30 年预测置信区间收窄 6.5% 且 RMSE 无损失；λ=0.1 时收窄 25% 但 RMSE 仅增加 0.84%。
标准超参数优化器以最小化一步 RMSE 选择 λ，作者认为这对递归预测中的结构性约束是错误指标。
残差校准过程噪声将双重不确定性框架的置信区间减少 53-60%，5 种子集成变异系数为 1.06%。
cards.limitations: 证据仅基于 6 个高寿命国家 1956-2020 年数据，样本外回测为 2011-2020 年；λ 的精度-稳定性权衡数值可能依赖数据集与网络结构，未在其他人口或模型上验证；监管输出示例仅涉及特定国家与性别组合，不能外推为普遍结论。
cards.originalTitle: Actuarial-Informed Neural Networks: Constrained Deep Learning for Sex-Specific Multi-Population Longevity Forecasting
cards.titleEn: Actuarial-Constrained Neural Networks Improve Stability of Multi-Population Longevity Forecasting
cards.descriptionEn: This study introduces Actuarial-Informed Neural Networks (AINN), a constrained deep learning framework that embeds actuarial knowledge into LSTM training via differentiable penalty terms for sex-specific multi-population longevity forecasting. Its novelty lies in showing that constraint intensity λ acts as a continuous governance dial that narrows forecast intervals with minimal accuracy cost, quantifying the accuracy-stability trade-off.
cards.summaryEn: The authors propose AINN, training a monotonicity-constrained LSTM on data from six high-longevity countries, and find that increasing λ from 0.01 to 0.1 narrows 30-year forecast confidence intervals by 6.5% and 25%, respectively, with RMSE costs of zero and +0.84%. They argue standard hyperparameter optimizers miss this trade-off because they minimize one-step RMSE. A 10-year out-of-sample backtest yields a mean absolute error of 0.38 years, with 11 of 12 country-by-sex combinations within the 90% confidence interval.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based only on six high-longevity countries over 1956-2020, with an out-of-sample backtest for 2011-2020; the numerical accuracy-stability trade-off for λ may depend on the dataset and network architecture and has not been validated on other populations or models; regulatory output examples cover only specific country-sex combinations and should not be generalized.

cards.whyItMatters: 该工作将市场状态标签的构造与下游分类器可学习性直接关联，提供可显式控制与评估的标签构建框架，有助于减少标签与预测信息脱节的问题，并为跨市场、跨架构的标签验证提供参考。
cards.summary: 事实：DDSL 通过模型反馈迭代优化九状态市场标签，在 SSE50、CSI300、CSI500 和 NASDAQ100 上留出宏 F1 提升 78%-96%，独立 GRU 复现趋势，标签熵与类别覆盖稳定。作者观点：可学习性受迭代次数和反馈权重 β_model 控制，迭代增益随标签系统收敛而递减，反馈增强会拉大反馈 Transformer 与独立 GRU 的差距。证据边界：外部验证仅为局部事件研究，A 股与 NASDAQ100 的 BEAR→BULL 反转信号方向相反。
keyPointsEn: DDSL iteratively couples a Viterbi labeler and a Transformer classifier through model feedback to construct a nine-state market representation.
On four indices, held-out joint-state macro F1 improves by 78%-96% over single-pass dynamic-programming labeling; an independent GRU reproduces the trend with stable label entropy.

Learnability is governed by iteration count and feedback weight β_model; iterative gains diminish, stronger feedback widens model gaps, and segment-level price-feature separation first improves then declines.
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work directly links market-state label construction to downstream classifier learnability, offering a framework for explicitly controlling and evaluating label construction. It helps reduce the mismatch between labels and prediction-time information and provides a reference for cross-market and cross-architecture label validation.
cards.title: DDSL：迭代自标注构建可学习市场状态
cards.description: DDSL 提出迭代自标注框架，将价格与语法引导的 Viterbi 标注器与 Transformer 分类器通过模型反馈耦合，解决传统独立标注导致标签不可学习的问题。在四个指数上，留出联合状态宏 F1 较单次动态规划标注提升 78%-96%，且独立 GRU 复现该趋势，表明增益可跨架构迁移。
keyPoints: DDSL 将 Viterbi 标注器与 Transformer 分类器通过模型反馈迭代耦合，构建九状态市场表示。
在四个指数上，留出联合状态宏 F1 较单次动态规划标注提升 78%-96%，独立 GRU 复现趋势且标签熵稳定。
可学习性受迭代次数与反馈权重 β_model 控制；迭代增益递减，反馈增强拉大模型间差距，但分段价格特征区分度先升后降。
cards.limitations: 证据限于四个指数的实验，外部验证仅为非 anticipative 事件研究且部分，A 股与 NASDAQ100 的反转信号方向相反，未证明普适性；标签学习性提升伴随分段价格特征区分度下降，需权衡；未涉及交易成本、滑点等实盘因素，不构成投资建议。
cards.originalTitle: DDSL: Iterative Self-Labeling for Financial Market States
cards.titleEn: DDSL: Iterative Self-Labeling for Learnable Market States
cards.descriptionEn: DDSL introduces an iterative self-labeling framework that couples a price- and grammar-guided Viterbi labeler with a Transformer classifier via model feedback, addressing the unlearnability of labels from conventional independent labeling. On four indices, held-out joint-state macro F1 improves by 78%-96% over single-pass dynamic-programming labeling, and an independent GRU reproduces the trend, indicating cross-architecture transferability.
cards.summaryEn: Fact: DDSL iteratively refines nine-state market labels via model feedback, improving held-out macro F1 by 78%-96% on SSE50, CSI300, CSI500, and NASDAQ100, with an independent GRU reproducing the trend and stable label entropy and class coverage. Author view: learnability is controlled by iteration count and feedback weight β_model; iterative gains diminish as label systems converge, while stronger feedback widens the gap between the feedback Transformer and the independent GRU. Evidence boundary: external validation is only a partial event study, and the BEAR→BULL reversal signal has opposite signs on A-share datasets versus NASDAQ100.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is limited to experiments on four indices; external validation is only a partial non-anticipative event study, and the reversal signal has opposite signs on A-share datasets versus NASDAQ100, so universality is not established. Improved label learnability coincides with declining segment-level price-feature separation, requiring trade-offs. Transaction costs, slippage, and other live-trading factors are not addressed; this is not investment advice.

cards.whyItMatters: 金融情感分析广泛应用于自动化交易、组合管理和风险评估，模型对语义反转的脆弱性可能威胁算法决策的完整性，该研究为开发逻辑感知的鲁棒金融 NLP 模型提供了实证依据。
cards.summary: 研究提出 ASI 攻击框架，通过领域特定的语义操纵使金融情感模型产生错误预测。实验表明 FinBERT 在 90.85% 的合格案例中被成功欺骗，且常维持原始情感预测 despite 财务指标的根本反转。作者认为 FinBERT 过度依赖上下文关键词和句法模式，而非真正理解金融语义逻辑，呼吁开发逻辑感知的鲁棒金融 NLP 模型。
keyPointsEn: The ASI framework uses an LLM-powered multi-agent pipeline to identify eligible financial news sentences and apply targeted lexical substitutions.
FinBERT is deceived in 90.85% of eligible cases, frequently maintaining its original sentiment prediction when financial performance indicators are inverted.
Qualitative analysis and token-level investigation indicate that FinBERT over-relies on contextual keywords and syntactic patterns rather than logical comprehension.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Financial sentiment analysis is widely used in automated trading, portfolio management, and risk assessment. The vulnerability of models to semantic inversion threatens the integrity of algorithmic decision-making, and this study provides empirical evidence for developing logic-aware robust financial NLP models.
cards.title: 金融情感模型易受语义反转攻击，FinBERT 误判率达 90.85%
cards.description: 该研究提出 Agent 驱动的语义反转（ASI）攻击框架，利用大语言模型多智能体管道对金融新闻句子进行针对性词汇替换，实证显示 FinBERT 在 90.85% 的合格案例中被欺骗，暴露了其依赖上下文关键词而非逻辑理解金融语义的脆弱性。这一发现对自动化交易、组合管理和风险评估等依赖情感分析的金融决策系统具有警示意义。
keyPoints: ASI 框架利用 LLM 多智能体管道识别合格金融新闻句子并执行针对性词汇替换。
FinBERT 在 90.85% 的合格案例中被欺骗，且经常在财务表现指标反转时仍保持原情感预测。
定性分析和 token 级调查表明 FinBERT 过度依赖上下文关键词和句法模式，而非逻辑理解。
cards.limitations: 研究仅针对 FinBERT 一个模型进行评估，未涵盖其他金融情感模型；攻击框架依赖 LLM 多智能体管道，其泛化性和实际部署场景中的有效性未经验证；结论基于论文中的实验设置，未涉及真实市场环境下的长期影响。
cards.originalTitle: Evaluating Semantic Insensitivity in Financial Sentiment Analysis: Implications for Sustainable Financial Decision-Making
cards.titleEn: Financial Sentiment Models Vulnerable to Semantic Inversion: FinBERT Misled in 90.85% of Cases
cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes Agent-driven Semantic Inversion (ASI), an adversarial attack framework that uses an LLM-powered multi-agent pipeline to perform targeted lexical substitutions in financial news sentences. Empirical evaluation shows FinBERT is deceived in 90.85% of eligible cases, exposing its reliance on contextual keywords rather than logical comprehension of financial semantics. This finding has implications for automated trading, portfolio management, and risk assessment
cards.summaryEn: The study introduces ASI, an attack framework that manipulates financial sentiment models through domain-specific semantic modifications. Experiments show FinBERT is successfully deceived in 90.85% of eligible cases, often maintaining its original sentiment prediction despite fundamental inversion of financial performance indicators. The authors argue that FinBERT over-relies on contextual keywords and syntactic patterns rather than true logical understanding of financial semantics, and call for logic-aware robust financial NLP models.
cards.limitationsEn: The study evaluates only FinBERT and does not cover other financial sentiment models; the attack framework relies on an LLM-powered multi-agent pipeline whose generalizability and effectiveness in real deployment scenarios are not validated; conclusions are based on the experimental setup in the paper and do not address long-term impacts in real market environments.

cards.whyItMatters: 该工作探索将预测与组合构建目标对齐的端到端路径，可能减少传统两阶段管线中学习目标与配置执行目标不一致的问题，并为在共享资金约束下同时配置多资产提供统一框架。
cards.summary: AllocFlow将信号预测与组合构建合并为单一端到端流程，使用跨资产流Transformer联合生成带符号的连续持仓权重。为缓解从零学习连续配置策略的样本效率低与不稳定问题，采用两阶段训练：先以策略监督模仿塑造候选组合分布，再用组相对强化学习结合组合级金融奖励和冻结策略参考进行精炼。作者报告在加密永续合约数据上RL精炼显著提升了收益与Calmar比率，并在未见数据上未重训即达到Calmar比率4.90。
keyPointsEn: A cross-asset flow Transformer conditioned on temporal market representations jointly generates continuous signed weights for all instruments.
Two-stage training: strategy-supervised imitation establishes a candidate portfolio distribution, and group-relative RL refines it using portfolio-level rewards and a frozen policy reference.
On hourly crypto perpetual futures, RL refinement reportedly raises the imitation policy's annualized net return from 27.79% to 51.38% and its Calmar ratio from 0.955 to 4.043.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The work explores an end-to-end path that aligns forecasting with portfolio construction objectives, potentially reducing the mismatch between learning targets and allocation/execution objectives in traditional two-stage pipelines, and offers a unified framework for allocating multiple assets under shared capital constraints.
cards.title: AllocFlow实现原始市场数据到组合动作的端到端生成
cards.description: 提出AllocFlow，一种基于流匹配的端到端框架，可直接从原始多资产市场历史生成联合组合配置，减少预测与组合构建分离带来的目标错位。在加密永续合约小时数据上，两阶段训练（策略监督模仿+组相对强化学习）将模仿策略的年化净收益从27.79%提升至51.38%，Calmar比率从0.955提升至4.043。
keyPoints: 跨资产流Transformer以时间市场表征为条件，联合生成所有标的的连续带符号权重。
两阶段训练：策略监督模仿建立候选组合分布，组相对RL利用组合级奖励与冻结策略参考进行精炼。
在小时级加密永续合约上报告RL精炼将模仿策略年化净收益由27.79%提升至51.38%，Calmar比率由0.955提升至4.043。
cards.limitations: 证据仅来自加密永续合约小时数据这一单一市场与频率，结论外推至股票、期货或其他频率需谨慎。文中未给出交易成本、滑点、容量与流动性约束的量化设定，收益与Calmar比率对成本假设的敏感性未知。两阶段训练与RL精炼的具体稳定性、样本效率及对超参数的敏感性缺乏充分披露；未见样本外数据仅六个月，长期稳健性证据有限。所述结果均为作者自报，未经独立复现。
cards.originalTitle: AllocFlow: End-to-End Portfolio Trading Action Generation from Raw Market Data
cards.titleEn: AllocFlow Generates Portfolio Actions End-to-End from Raw Market Data
cards.descriptionEn: Introduces AllocFlow, an end-to-end flow-matching framework that directly generates joint portfolio allocations from raw multi-asset market histories, reducing misalignment between forecasting and portfolio construction. On hourly crypto perpetual futures, two-stage training (strategy-supervised imitation plus group-relative reinforcement learning) raises the imitation policy's annualized net return from 27.79% to 51.38% and its Calmar ratio from 0.955 to 4.043.
cards.summaryEn: AllocFlow merges signal forecasting and portfolio construction into a single end-to-end pipeline, using a cross-asset flow Transformer to jointly generate continuous signed position weights across instruments. To address sample inefficiency and instability in learning continuous allocation policies from scratch, it uses two-stage training: strategy-supervised imitation to shape a candidate portfolio distribution, followed by group-relative reinforcement learning with portfolio-level financial rewards and a frozen policy reference. The authors report that RL refinement substantially improves return and Calmar ratio on crypto perpetual futures, reaching a Calmar ratio of 4.90 on unseen data without retraining.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes only from hourly crypto perpetual futures, a single market and frequency, so extrapolation to equities, futures, or other frequencies requires caution. The paper does not quantify trading costs, slippage, capacity, or liquidity constraints, and sensitivity of returns and Calmar ratios to cost assumptions is unknown. Details on the stability, sample efficiency, and hyperparameter sensitivity of two-stage training and RL refinement are not fully disclosed; out-of-sample data cover only six months, limiting evidence on long-term robustness. Reported results are author-reported and not independently replicated.

cards.whyItMatters: 该研究为新兴的算法保险市场提供了可操作的定价框架，将AI系统设计中的阈值选择与责任暴露联系起来，有助于保险公司评估AI风险，也为开发者通过合同设计降低责任、提升系统安全性提供了依据。
cards.summary: 论文指出，AI在高风险领域中的错误会造成异质性损失，传统保险难以定价。作者用条件风险价值（CVaR）刻画极端损失，证明准确率最大化可能大幅增加最坏情况损失，并提出强制风险感知阈值的责任保险合同。案例显示，准确率最大化阈值的尾部风险可达CVaR最优阈值的四倍，保险合同对校准良好的公司带来7%-8%收益，对校准差的公司可达105%。
keyPointsEn: Decision-threshold choice is directly linked to tail-risk exposure; accuracy maximization can significantly increase worst-case losses.
The proposed liability insurance contract requires risk-aware thresholds, enabling both risk transfer and AI safety improvement.
In the mammography case study, accuracy-maximizing thresholds carry up to four times the tail risk of CVaR-optimal thresholds.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The research provides an operational pricing framework for the emerging algorithmic insurance market, connecting threshold choices in AI system design to liability exposure, helping insurers assess AI risk and developers reduce liability and improve safety through contract design.
cards.title: 算法保险：决策阈值如何影响AI尾部风险定价
cards.description: 研究将二元分类中决策阈值的设定与AI系统极端损失风险（CVaR）直接关联，证明准确率最大化会显著放大最坏情况损失，并提出一种要求风险感知阈值的责任保险合同，为保险公司定价AI风险、开发者管理责任暴露提供了新框架。
keyPoints: 决策阈值选择与尾部风险暴露直接相关，准确率最大化可能显著增加最坏情况损失。
提出的责任保险合同要求采用风险感知阈值，可同时实现风险转移和AI安全改进。
在乳腺钼靶案例中，准确率最大化阈值的尾部风险最高为CVaR最优阈值的四倍。
cards.limitations: 结论基于二元分类设定和CVaR风险度量，案例仅限于乳腺钼靶，合同收益数值（7%-8%、105%）依赖于模型校准假设；对多分类、回归任务或更复杂损失结构的适用性尚未验证，且未考虑实际保险市场的监管与竞争动态。
cards.titleEn: Algorithmic Insurance: How Decision Thresholds Shape AI Tail-Risk Pricing
cards.descriptionEn: The study directly links decision-threshold setting in binary classification to extreme-loss risk (CVaR) of AI systems, proves that accuracy maximization can significantly amplify worst-case losses, and proposes a liability insurance contract that mandates risk-aware thresholds, offering a new framework for insurers to price AI risk and for developers to manage liability exposure.
cards.summaryEn: The paper notes that AI errors in high-stakes domains cause heterogeneous losses that challenge traditional insurance pricing. Using conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) to capture extreme losses, the authors prove that accuracy maximization can substantially increase worst-case losses and propose a liability insurance contract mandating risk-aware thresholds. In a case study, accuracy-maximizing thresholds carry up to four times the tail risk of CVaR-optimal thresholds; insurance contracts yield 7-8% gains for well-calibrated firms and up to 105% for poorly calibrated firms.
cards.limitationsEn: Conclusions are based on binary classification and CVaR risk measure, with a case study limited to mammography; contract gain figures (7-8%, 105%) depend on model calibration assumptions. Applicability to multi-class, regression, or more complex loss structures is unverified, and real-world insurance market regulation and competition dynamics are not considered.

cards.whyItMatters: 为大型推理模型提供步骤感知的长度控制方法，有望在严格上下文约束的智能体系统中平衡推理准确性与计算效率。
cards.summary: 论文指出大型推理模型存在推理冗余问题，全局长度惩罚未能区分步骤价值。作者提出 SmartThinker 框架，通过步骤级长度控制策略优化（SCPO）在线估计每步贡献，并定义推理密度以差异化长度压力。实验声称在九个基准上取得更优的准确率-效率权衡。
keyPointsEn: SCPO provides label-free step-level feedback by online estimation of the change in correct-answer likelihood after removing a step.
It introduces reasoning density (contribution per token) to relax length pressure on high-value steps and intensify compression on low-density ones.
It stabilizes training through length-bias-corrected advantages and difficulty-adaptive clipping.
cards.whyItMattersEn: It offers a step-aware length control method for large reasoning models, potentially balancing reasoning accuracy and computational efficiency in agent systems with strict context constraints.
cards.title: SmartThinker：面向大推理模型的步骤级令牌分配框架
cards.description: 现有方法通过全局长度惩罚压缩推理链，但忽略步骤级结构，可能压缩关键推导并保留低价值绕路。SmartThinker 提出步骤级令牌分配框架，学习选择性保留或压缩推理步骤，以提升推理效率。
keyPoints: SCPO 通过在线估计移除某步骤后正确答案似然的变化，提供无标签的步骤贡献反馈。
引入推理密度（贡献每令牌）来放松高价值步骤的长度压力，并加强对低密度步骤的压缩。
采用长度偏差校正的优势估计和难度自适应裁剪来稳定训练。
cards.limitations: 摘要未提供具体实验数据、基准细节或与基线方法的量化对比；步骤贡献的在线估计依赖正确答似然变化，其可靠性可能受模型校准影响；方法在复杂问题上的训练稳定性与探索平衡仍需实证检验。
cards.originalTitle: SmartThinker: Learning High-Density Reasoning via Step-Level Token Allocation
cards.titleEn: SmartThinker: A Step-Level Token Allocation Framework for Large Reasoning Models
cards.descriptionEn: Existing methods compress reasoning chains via global length penalties but overlook step-level structure, potentially compressing critical derivations while retaining low-value detours. SmartThinker proposes a step-level token allocation framework that learns to selectively preserve or compress reasoning steps to improve reasoning efficiency.
cards.summaryEn: The paper identifies redundancy in large reasoning models and notes that global length penalties fail to distinguish step value. The authors propose SmartThinker, a framework with Step-Level Length Control Policy Optimization (SCPO) that estimates each step's contribution online and defines reasoning density to differentiate length pressure. Experiments claim superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across nine benchmarks.
cards.limitationsEn: The abstract lacks specific experimental data, benchmark details, or quantitative comparisons with baselines; the online estimation of step contribution relies on changes in correct-answer likelihood, whose reliability may be affected by model calibration; training stability and exploration balance on complex problems require empirical verification.

cards.whyItMatters: 该研究提示量化研究员在构建日内股票预测模型时，不能默认“更多历史数据更好”或“近期数据更优”，而应将训练历史选择与目标预测期限联合评估，避免因策略与期限错配导致模型性能下降。
cards.summary: 研究在固定Transformer架构下，比较了四种采样验证策略与6、12、24个月训练量对5至120分钟8个预测期限的影响，采用2025年1月至2026年10月的月滚动前向实验。结果表明不存在普适最优策略：近期采样在5-15分钟领先，多近期配置在20-30分钟领先，均匀采样在60-120分钟领先；增加训练量并非一致提升精度。所有模型等权集成在15、20、25分钟优于个体均值，其余期限则不然。
keyPointsEn: Recency sampling (6 months) performs best at 5-15 minute horizons, multi-recency configurations lead at 20-30 minutes, and uniform sampling dominates at 60-120 minutes.
Increasing training data quantity (from 6 to 24 months) does not uniformly improve forecast accuracy; training history selection interacts with forecast horizon.
An equal-weight ensemble of all 12 models exceeds individual means at 15, 20, and 25 minutes but shows no advantage at other horizons.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The study cautions quantitative researchers against assuming that 'more history is better' or 'recent data is superior' when building intraday equity forecasting models; instead, training history selection should be jointly evaluated with the target forecast horizon to avoid performance degradation from strategy-horizon mismatch.
cards.title: 股票Transformer中训练历史选择与多预测期限的交互作用
cards.description: 该研究在固定横截面Transformer架构下，系统考察了不同训练数据采样与验证策略及训练数据量如何与日内股票预测的期限相互作用，揭示了训练历史选择对预测精度的期限依赖性，为量化模型训练策略的期限匹配提供了实证依据。
keyPoints: 近期采样（6个月）在5-15分钟预测期限表现最佳，多近期配置在20-30分钟领先，均匀采样在60-120分钟占优。
增加训练数据量（从6至24个月）并未一致提升预测精度，训练历史选择与预测期限存在交互。
全部12个模型等权集成在15、20、25分钟超过个体均值，但在其他期限未显示优势。
cards.limitations: 研究仅使用一个固定Transformer架构和特征集，未识别因果效应；评估期限为5至120分钟，结论未必适用于更长或更短期限；样本期覆盖2025年1月至2026年10月的特定市场环境，跨市场与跨时期的泛化性未经验证；未提供交易成本调整后的净收益分析。
cards.originalTitle: Which Past Matters? Training History and Multi-Forecast Horizon in Equity Transformers
cards.titleEn: Interaction Between Training History Selection and Multi-Horizon Forecasting in Equity Transformers
cards.descriptionEn: This study systematically examines how different training data sampling and validation policies and training data quantities interact with forecast horizons in intraday equity prediction under a fixed cross-sectional Transformer architecture, providing empirical evidence for horizon-matched training strategy design in quantitative models.
cards.summaryEn: Under a fixed Transformer architecture, the study compares four sampling/validation policies and 6, 12, 24-month training quantities across 8 forecast horizons from 5 to 120 minutes, using monthly walk-forward experiments from January 2025 to October 2026. No universally optimal policy exists: recency sampling leads at 5-15 minutes, multi-recency configurations lead at 20-30 minutes, and uniform sampling leads at 60-120 minutes; increasing training quantity does not uniformly improve accuracy. An equal-weight ensemble of all models outperforms individual means at 15, 20, and 25 minutes but not at other horizons.
cards.limitationsEn: The study uses only one fixed Transformer architecture and feature set and does not identify causal effects; evaluation horizons span 5 to 120 minutes, so conclusions may not extend to longer or shorter horizons; the sample period covers specific market conditions from January 2025 to October 2026, and cross-market and cross-period generalizability is unverified; no transaction-cost-adjusted net return analysis is provided.

cards.whyItMatters: 为动态投资组合子空间传输提供更高精度且可逆的更新方案，有助于减少因度量变化引入的累积误差，提升组合跟踪与风险管理的数值稳健性。
cards.summary: 研究分析风险度量变化下投资组合暴露在移动子空间间的传输。发现风险加权Procrustes存在一阶局部误差，揭示度量形变与子空间法向协变运动的耦合。几何均值对齐与对称Procrustes构造能消除该误差，获得二阶全局精度和可逆更新，并建立非均匀划分下的均匀误差界。
keyPointsEn: Identifies a leading local error term in risk-weighted Procrustes that couples metric deformation with covariant motion normal to the subspace.
Geometric mean alignment and symmetric Procrustes constructions cancel this error, preserve reversibility, and achieve second-order global accuracy.
Establishes uniform error bounds on nonuniform partitions, distinguishes discretization error from estimated geometry error, and relates to the connection induced by principal square root whitening.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Provides more accurate and reversible update schemes for dynamic portfolio subspace transport, helping to reduce accumulated errors from metric changes and improve numerical robustness in portfolio tracking and risk management.
cards.title: 动态投资组合子空间传输的二阶精度修正方案
cards.description: 该研究指出，在风险度量变化时，风险加权Procrustes传输存在一阶局部误差，会降低整体精度至一阶；提出几何均值对齐和对称Procrustes构造可消除该误差，实现二阶全局精度和可逆更新。
keyPoints: 识别风险加权Procrustes的主导局部误差项，该误差耦合度量形变与子空间法向协变运动。
几何均值对齐和对称Procrustes构造可消除该误差项，保持更新可逆性并达到二阶全局精度。
建立非均匀划分下的均匀误差界，区分离散化误差与估计几何误差，并联系主平方根白化诱导的连接。
cards.limitations: 结论主要基于理论推导与人工制造示例；历史几何压力测试仅基于观测数据估计缺陷并预测后续分离，未进行完整经济实现评估；实际市场中的表现及估计几何误差的影响需进一步检验。
cards.originalTitle: A Second Order Transport Scheme for Dynamic Portfolio Subspaces under a Varying Risk Metric
cards.titleEn: Second-order accurate transport scheme for dynamic portfolio subspaces
cards.descriptionEn: The study identifies a first-order local error in risk-weighted Procrustes transport when the risk metric varies, which can reduce global accuracy to first order; it proposes geometric mean alignment and a symmetric Procrustes construction that cancel this error, achieving second-order global accuracy and reversible updates.
cards.summaryEn: The research analyzes the transport of portfolio exposures between moving subspaces under a varying risk metric. A leading local error in risk-weighted Procrustes is identified, coupling metric deformation with covariant motion normal to the subspace. Geometric mean alignment and symmetric Procrustes constructions cancel the error, yielding second-order global accuracy and reversible updates, with uniform error bounds on nonuniform partitions.
cards.limitationsEn: Conclusions are mainly based on theoretical derivation and manufactured examples; the historical geometry stress test only estimates the defect from observations and predicts subsequent separation, without full economic implementation evaluation; practical market performance and the impact of estimated geometry errors require further testing.

cards.whyItMatters: 如果框架确实可用，它可能降低为智能体搭建技能体系与开发流程的重复成本，并为团队提供统一的组织约定；对关注 AI 工具落地方式的研究者与开发者具有参考价值，但当前仅凭简介无法判断其实际效果。
cards.summary: 该项目为 GitHub 趋势项目 obra/superpowers，项目简介称其为可用的智能体技能框架与软件开发方法论。输入内容仅有这一句简介，未提供架构说明、使用示例或评测结果。上述定位属项目自述，尚不能视为已被独立验证的结论。
keyPointsEn: The project describes itself as an 'agentic skills framework', suggesting a structured approach to organizing and reusing skills for AI agents.
It also claims to be a software development methodology, placing agent capabilities and development workflow in one framework.
Appearing on GitHub Trending Daily indicates a short-term rise in attention, but popularity is not evidence of technical effectiveness.
cards.whyItMattersEn: If the framework works as claimed, it could reduce duplicated effort in building skill systems and development workflows for agents and give teams shared conventions; it is therefore a reference point for researchers and developers tracking AI tool adoption, though effectiveness cannot be judged from the description alone.
cards.title: obra/superpowers：面向智能体的技能框架与开发方法
cards.description: 该项目在 GitHub 趋势榜出现，自称是一套可用的智能体技能框架与软件开发方法论；其价值在于为 AI 智能体提供可复用的技能组织方式，并配以开发流程建议，但输入未给出具体实现与验证细节。

项目同时自称一种软件开发方法论，把智能体能力与开发流程放在同一框架下讨论。

cards.titleEn: obra/superpowers: An Agentic Skills Framework and Development Methodology
cards.descriptionEn: The project appears on GitHub Trending and describes itself as a working agentic skills framework and software development methodology; its value lies in offering a reusable way to organize agent skills alongside a development process, though the input gives no implementation or validation details.
cards.summaryEn: The project is obra/superpowers, a GitHub Trending item whose description calls it a working agentic skills framework and software development methodology. The input contains only that single-line description, with no architecture, usage examples, or evaluation results. That positioning is the project's own claim and should not be treated as independently verified.

cards.whyItMatters: 对构建 AI 代理的团队而言，数据获取与来源接入往往是重复性工程；若该统一 API 可用，可能降低整合多个数据提供方的接入成本，使团队把精力集中在代理逻辑上。
cards.summary: 项目自述为面向 AI 代理的知识基础设施，通过一个 API 提供搜索、抓取并接入 550 多家数据提供方。上述能力与数量均为来源描述，未在输入中给出性能数据或实现细节。是否适用于具体场景需结合自身需求进一步验证。
keyPointsEn: Provides search and scraping plus access to 550+ data providers via a unified API
Positioned as underlying infrastructure to give AI agents broader knowledge access
Replaces separate integrations with a single entry point
cards.whyItMattersEn: For teams building AI agents, data acquisition and source integration are often repetitive engineering work; if the unified API works as described, it could reduce the cost of integrating multiple data providers and let teams focus on agent logic.
cards.title: Firecrawl：统一 API 聚合搜索、抓取与550家数据源

集成方式以单一入口替代多来源分别对接

cards.titleEn: Firecrawl: One API for Search, Scraping and 550+ Data Providers
cards.descriptionEn: This GitHub project combines web search, scraping and 550+ data providers behind a single API, aiming to serve as reusable knowledge infrastructure for AI agents. Its novelty lies in consolidating fragmented retrieval and data-access capabilities into one entry point, which may reduce integration overhead for agent builders.
cards.summaryEn: The project describes itself as knowledge infrastructure for AI agents, offering search, scraping and access to 550+ data providers through one API. These capabilities and the provider count come from the source description, with no performance data or implementation details provided. Applicability to specific use cases requires further verification.

The makeup and availability of the 550+ providers cannot be verified. cards.whyItMatters: 该技能包将漏洞报告模式与红队工作流整合进 Claude Code，可能帮助安全研究人员更系统地复用历史漏洞模式并组织攻击路径，但实际效果需结合使用场景验证。
cards.summary: Claude-BugHunter 是 GitHub 上的一个 Claude Code 技能包，声称包含 82 个技能、15 个斜杠命令和 681 个已披露报告模式，覆盖 24 类核心漏洞。项目还提供企业身份和基础设施攻击矩阵。以上信息来自仓库的简要描述，并非独立验证的结论。
keyPointsEn: The bundle includes 82 skills and 15 slash commands, targeting bug hunting and external red-team scenarios.
It curates 681 disclosed-report patterns across 24 core vulnerability classes.

cards.limitationsEn: The input content is only from the GitHub Trending Daily repository description and provides no skill details, usage cases, or effectiveness evaluation; the specific sources and screening criteria for the 681 report patterns and 24 vulnerability classes are unknown; this tool does not constitute investment advice, and users should assess applicability and compliance before use.

cards.whyItMatters: 若智能体无法跨会话积累经验，重复调试将浪费大量时间；具备记忆能力的自适应智能体有望提升长期运行效率，对AI智能体在量化等领域的持续应用具有潜在价值。
cards.summary: DeepLearning.AI 指出多数 AI 智能体在会话间不保留信息，今天花时间修复的错误明天仍会重犯。自适应智能体则能记住修复方案，下次跳过该错误。该内容为宣传性介绍，事实描述基于其观察，观点强调构建随每次运行而改进的智能体。
keyPointsEn: Most AI agents carry nothing forward between sessions, leading to repeated mistakes.
Adaptive agents remember fixes and can skip the same error next time.
DeepLearning.AI and Oracle offer a free short course, 'Building Adaptive AI Agents,' covering related methods.
cards.whyItMattersEn: If agents cannot accumulate experience across sessions, repeated debugging wastes substantial time; memory-enabled adaptive agents could improve long-term efficiency, with potential value for sustained AI agent applications such as quantitative finance.
cards.title: AI智能体重复犯错源于缺乏跨会话记忆
cards.description: 该内容指出多数AI智能体在会话之间不携带任何信息，导致重复犯错；自适应智能体通过记忆修复方案避免重犯，对构建持续改进的智能体有启发。
keyPoints: 多数AI智能体在会话之间不携带任何信息，导致重复犯错。
自适应智能体记住修复方案，下次遇到同类错误时可跳过。
DeepLearning.AI与Oracle合作推出免费短课程《Building Adaptive AI Agents》讲解相关方法。
cards.limitations: 该内容为课程宣传材料，仅提出观察和主张，未提供具体实验数据、量化效果或可复现的评估结果；自适应智能体的实际改进幅度和适用边界尚不明确。
cards.titleEn: AI Agents Repeat Mistakes Due to Lack of Cross-Session Memory
cards.descriptionEn: The content notes that most AI agents carry nothing forward between sessions, causing repeated mistakes; adaptive agents remember fixes to avoid recurrence, offering insight for building continuously improving agents.
cards.summaryEn: DeepLearning.AI points out that most AI agents do not retain information across sessions, so an error fixed today is repeated tomorrow. Adaptive agents remember the fix and skip the mistake next time. The content is promotional; the factual observation is theirs, while the emphasis on building agents that improve with every run is an opinion.
cards.limitationsEn: This is course promotional material that offers only observations and claims, without specific experimental data, quantified results, or reproducible evaluations; the actual improvement magnitude and applicable boundaries of adaptive agents remain unclear.

cards.whyItMatters: 对量化研究者而言，把想法验证流程工具化并保留测试与审核环节，有助于减少实现错误和事后挑选，让想法是否推进的依据更可追溯；课程面向能读简短 Python 脚本并理解收益率与移动平均的人群。
cards.summary: 工作坊由 QuantInsti 举办，2026 年 12 月 5、6、12、13 日四场直播，12 月 4 日另有环境设置场，计划构建七个 Claude Code 技能，覆盖数据获取清洗、把想法转为可测试规则、含成本回测、对照基准写报告、记录每次优化测试和监控模拟交易，最后以“想法工厂管理器”统一跑检查并维护记分板。主办方称每个结果均由测试、审核子代理和参与者本人复核，由参与者决定哪些想法继续推进。上述内容属于课程安排与主办方主张，并非独立验证的实证结论。
keyPointsEn: Seven skills span the research chain from market data fetching and cleaning to paper-trade monitoring
Backtests explicitly include trading costs and require reporting against a benchmark
Every optimization test is logged, and an Ideas Factory Manager applies shared checks and a scoreboard to screen ideas
cards.whyItMattersEn: For quantitative researchers, tooling the idea-validation process while keeping tests and review steps can reduce implementation errors and after-the-fact selection, making the basis for advancing an idea more traceable; the course targets people who can read a short Python script and understand returns and moving averages.
cards.title: Claude Code 交易研究工作坊：七个技能构建与校验流程
cards.description: 该工作坊介绍如何用 Claude Code 搭建交易研究流程，新在将取数与清洗数据、规则化、含成本回测、基准报告、优化记录与模拟盘监控拆成七个可复用技能，并以测试、审核子代理和人工复核校验结果；用途是帮助能读简短 Python 脚本的从业者判断交易想法是否经得起数据与成本检验。
keyPoints: 七个技能覆盖从市场数据获取清洗到模拟盘监控的完整研究链条
回测明确计入交易成本，并要求对照基准撰写报告
每次优化测试都需记录，“想法工厂管理器”用统一检查与记分板筛选想法
cards.limitations: 信息来源为课程宣传材料，未提供课程效果、技能质量或回测结果的独立证据；所描述的检查机制是否足以避免过拟合、数据泄漏等常见问题，材料未作说明；课程不构成投资建议，历史表现不保证未来结果。
cards.originalTitle: Claude Code for Trading Research Bootcamp | Live, December 2026
cards.titleEn: Claude Code Trading Research Bootcamp: Seven Skills and a Verification Workflow
cards.descriptionEn: The bootcamp presents a Claude Code-based trading research workflow: it splits data fetching and cleaning, rule specification, cost-inclusive backtesting, benchmark reporting, optimization logging and paper-trade monitoring into seven reusable skills, with results checked by tests, a reviewer sub-agent and the participant. It is aimed at people who can read a short Python script and want to judge whether a trading idea survives data and cost checks.
cards.summaryEn: Run by QuantInsti, the bootcamp has four live sessions on 5, 6, 12 and 13 December 2026, plus a setup session on 4 December, and plans seven Claude Code skills covering market data fetching and cleaning, turning ideas into testable rules, cost-inclusive backtesting, benchmark-based reporting, logging every optimization test and monitoring paper trades. A final Ideas Factory Manager is said to run each new idea through the same checks and keep a scoreboard. Organizers state that every result is checked by tests, a reviewer sub-agent and the participant, who decides which ideas move forward; these are course arrangements and organizer claims, not independently verified findings.
cards.limitationsEn: The source is course promotional material and provides no independent evidence on course effectiveness, skill quality or backtest results; whether the described checks are sufficient to avoid overfitting, data leakage and other common pitfalls is not addressed; the course is not investment advice and past performance does not guarantee future results.
